These PCM16 mono WAV fixtures were generated locally with macOS `say` (Tingting and Samantha), then converted to 16 kHz. They contain synthetic speech, not microphone recordings.

- `speech-zh.wav`: a short Chinese request.
- `speech-en.wav`: a short English greeting.

They test the pinned Silero VAD adapter's utterance boundaries and irregular callback sizes. They are not a speech accuracy benchmark.
